scripts.dev: pnpm build && vp run --filter nuxt-photo-playground --fail-if-no-match dev
scripts.dev:docs: pnpm build && vp run --filter nuxt-photo-docs --fail-if-no-match dev
scripts.build:playground: pnpm build && vp run --filter nuxt-photo-playground --fail-if-no-match build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:apps && vp run --filter '@lupinum/*photo' --fail-if-no-match typecheck && vp run --filter nuxt-photo-playground --filter nuxt-photo-docs --fail-if-no-match typecheck
scripts.test:compat: pnpm build && vp run --filter '@lupinum/*photo' --fail-if-no-match typecheck && vp test
scripts.docs:build: pnpm build && pnpm docs:check && vp run --filter nuxt-photo-docs --fail-if-no-match build
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/docs/validate.mjs && node scripts/docs/check-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-theme.mjs && node scripts/docs/generate-skill-references.mjs --check
scripts.verify: pnpm audit --audit-level=high && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:packed && pnpm size --skip-build && pnpm docs:build && pnpm test:browser
